question: Which is the only streptococcal species widely used in food fermentation, especially for yogurt manufacturing?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Streptococcus thermophilus.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• The only **streptococcal species **frequently employed in **food fermentations**, particularly for the production of **yoghurt**, is** Streptococcus thermophilus**.
 
• For thousands of years, it has been used as a **seed combined **with **Lactobacillus bulgaricus **to make yoghurt.
